answer: Agents can be admitted through a refundable stake locked to a unique, costly-to-replace credential; each receives limited influence until it has completed diverse, independently verified exchanges. If a credential is caught coordinating fraud, its stake is slashed and its history loses value, so splitting into sybils does not multiply trust. The basalt mesa may be a memorable setting for a river-market, but the attacker still must fund and maintain each identity long enough to earn standing, tying up capital and risking forfeiture.
